title: [Ruling A on #22649] create-objectstack installs the skills catalog from the installed @objectstack/skills package, not from GitHub main; the scaffolded project depends on it at the spec's version
body:
Blocked-by: #22658

Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer directed by ruling — #22649 letter **A**, maintainer 「22649 同意 A」, record 6096124407 (skills seat 1, `session_01RdnZdPZH9ByduzPRWuH9tN`, this seat's session chat, 2026-10-10). Ruling-ref: 6096124407. The cli-lane third of that ruling's execution; filed by the skills seat under the maintainer's direct-dispatch channel; triage may re-grade on first touch. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** the `domain:cli` seat, after #22658 (the `@objectstack/skills` package) is published and installable — the unlock test is the consumer's install (`npm view @objectstack/skills version` answers), not the merge. **Surface:** `packages/create-objectstack/src/skills-install.ts`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts` (the `--skip-skills` path and the closing summary), the project templates' `package.json` (a dependency on `@objectstack/skills` at the same version as `@objectstack/spec`), `created-summary.ts` and the scaffold e2e / created-summary tests. ⛔ No change to `skills/**`.

## Done when

- A scaffolded project's `package.json` depends on `@objectstack/skills` at the version it depends on `@objectstack/spec` (the fixed group keeps them equal).
- After `<pm> install`, the catalog lands in the chosen agent's directory from `node_modules/@objectstack/skills`: through `npx skills experimental_sync` if #22658's measurement says the layout fits, otherwise by the scaffolder's own copy (one function; the same one-agent destination rule `skills-install.ts`'s header measured). The GitHub `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills` command disappears from the scaffolder's output and its summary; the summary prints the package-based re-install command.
- `--skip-skills` keeps its meaning; `--skip-install` implies no skills yet (nothing in `node_modules`) and the summary says how to get them.
- The scaffold e2e asserts the installed skill set equals the package's catalog (count and names); the created-summary test's phase-3 layout follows the new installer.
- Changeset: `minor` for `create-objectstack` (a scaffolded project's dependency set changes); `Clause-②: no`.

**Workload (per the ruling):** M; precedent `packages/create-objectstack/src/skills-install.ts` (the one-agent install rework) and its e2e.

Dedupe: REST listing `labels=domain:skills&state=all&since=2026-08-01` (12 pages, 1,150 cards) grepped for `version|compat|bind|npx skills|skills add|catalog|release` → 0 cards on the catalog binding before #22649; this card is one third of #22649's execution; open titles grepped for `@objectstack/skills` → 0.
